ट: ट The 11th consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, and first of the 3rd class or cerebrals. It corresponds in sound to the letter T pronounced far back in the mouth, or as in true, and is expressed in the roman character by the accented letter T.

ट m. (-टः) 1 Sound, or a particular sound, like the twang of a bow strong. 2 A dwarf. 3 A quarter, a fourth. n. (-टं) A hollowed cocoanut. f. (टा) 1 The earth. 2 An oath, confirming an assertion by ordeal, &c. E. टक to bind, &c. affix ड.
टक: टक (इ) टकि r. 1st and 10th cls. (टङ्कति टङ्कयति) To bind, to tie.
टगर: टगर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Squint-eyed. m. (-रः) 1 Borax. 2 Wanton play or sport. 3 Wandering of the mind, confusion, perplexity. 4 An object of sense.
टङ्क: टङ्क mn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्कं) 1 A kind of elephant or wood apple. नीलकपित्थ. 2 Borax. 3 A spade or hoe. m. (-ङ्कः) 1 A hatchet or stone cutter's chisel. 2 A sword, a scimitar, a sacrificial hatchet or knife. 3 A scabbard, a sword-sheath. 4 Anger, wrath. 5 A weight (of silver) equal to four māṣas. 6 A coin. 7 Pride, arrogance. 8 A cleft, a chasm. 9 A peak. f. (-ङ्गा) 1 The leg. 2 The edge or side of a mountain. E. टकि to bind, affix अच्; or ट imitative, कै to emit sound, affix ड, and नुम् augment.
टङ्कक: टङ्कक m. (-कः) A stamped coin, especially of silver. E. कन् added to टङ्क a weight of silver.
टङ्ककपति: टङ्ककपति m. (-तिः) The master of a mint or superintendent of the silver coin. E. टङ्कक, and पति master.
टङ्ककशाला: टङ्ककशाला f. (-ला) A mint. E. टङ्कक, and शाला a hall.
टङ्कटीक: टङ्कटीक m. (-कः) A name of ŚIVA. E. टङ्क an axe, and टीक who has, from टीक to go or get, affix अच्.
टङ्कण: टङ्कण n. (-णं) 1 Borax. 2 Binding, tying. E. टङ्क to bind, affix ल्युट्.
टङ्कपति: टङ्कपति m. (-तिः) The master of the mint. E. टङ्क a weight of silver put for a coin, and पति master.
टङ्कशाला: टङ्कशाला f. (-ला) A mint. E. टङ्क see the last, and शाला a house or hall.
टङ्कार: टङ्कार m. (-रः) 1 Surprise, wonder. 2 Fame, notoriety. 3 The twang of a bow string. E. टकि to bind, &c. affix आरक्; or ट twang, in the second case, कृ to make, affix अण्.
टङ्ग: टङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A spade or hoe. 2 An axe. 3 The leg. 4 Borax. 5 A weight of four māṣas. E. टकि to bind, affix अच्, क changed to गः otherwise टङ्क as above; also with ल्युट् affix, टङ्गन n. (-नं)
टट्टनी: टट्टनी f. (-नी) A house lizard. E. टट्ट imitative sound, and न what makes, from नी, affixes ड and ङीष्.
टट्टरी: टट्टरी f. (-री) 1 A joke, a jest. 2 A kettle drum. 3 Any musical instrument. E. टट्ट imitative sound, and र what makes, from रा, with ड and ङीष् affs.
टट्टुर: टट्टुर m. (-रः) The sound of a drum. E. टट्टु imitative sound, tattoo, and र what gets or has.
टल: टल r. 1st cl. (टलति) To be confused, to be disturbed by fear, anxiety, &c.
टलन: टलन n. (-नं) Anxiety, perturbation. E. टल to be disturbed, ल्युट् aff.
टाङ्कर: टाङ्कर m. (-रः) A blackguard, a lecher, a libertine. E. टां an oath, and कर who takes.
टार: टार m. (-रः) 1 A horse. 2 A catamite.
टिक: टिक (ऋ) टिकृ r. 1st cl. (टेकते) To go or move.
टिटिभक: टिटिभक m. (-कः) A bird: see the next.
टिट्टिभ: टिट्टिभ m. (-भः) A bird, (Parra jacana or goensis.) E. टिट्टि imitative sound, भास to utter, affix ड; also with कन् added, टिट्टिभक; also टिटिभक, टिठिभक, &c.
टिण्डिश: टिण्डिश m. (-शः) A kind of tree.
टिप: टिप r. 10th cl. (टेपयति) To direct, to send, to throw or cast: the act of throwing being considered analogous to that of sending or ordering.
टिप्पनी: टिप्पनी f. (-नी) A gloss, a comment.
टीक: टीक (ऋ) टीकृ r. 1st cl. (टीकते) To go or move.
टीका: टीका f. (-का) A commentary. E. टीक to go, affix अङ् and टाप्; by which the sense of the text proceeds.
टु: टु m. (-टुः) 1 Gold. 2 A Proteus, a changer of shapes at will. 3 KAMA or love.
टुण्ठुक: टुण्ठुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Low, little, vile. 2 Cruel, harsh. m. (-कः) 1 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) 2 A black species of catechu. 3 A small bird, (Silvia sutoria.) f. (-का) A plant, commonly Aknidhi: see टङ्गिनी. E. टुण्ठु imitative sound, and क what utters.
टेपन: टेपन n. (-नं) 1 Sending. 2 Throwing. E. टिप to throw, ल्युट् aff.
टौक: टौक m. (ऋ) टौकृ r. 1st cl. (टौकते) To go, to move.
ट्वल: ट्वल r. 1st cl. (ट्वलति) To be disturbed or confused: see टल. ठ
